region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis patient writer HCAPDB01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it INSERTs a PATIENT row (patient id DEFAULT, an identity column), reads the new id with IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL and returns it in CA-PATIENT-ID. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: add-patient

commarea.CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC: 1234567890Ada       Lovelace            1985-12-101 Analytical Way    London              AB1 2CD   07700900001         ada@example.org                                   ALOVELACE

scenarios.why: EIBCALEN covers the header: one PATIENT row inserted with the identity default, the new id returned in CA-PATIENT-ID, CA-RETURN-CODE '00'

scenarios.name: add-second-patient

commarea.CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC: 2234567890Alan      Turing              1990-06-232 Bombe Road        Bletchley           MK3 4EF   07700900002         alan@example.org                                  ATURING

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea

commarea.CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC: 1234567890Ada       Lovelace            1985-12-101 Analytical Way    London              AB1 2CD   07700900001         ada@example.org                                   ALOVELACE

scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98' to CA-RETURN-CODE, RETURN before the INSERT

scenarios.name: invalid-date-of-birth

commarea.CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC: 3234567890Bad       Date                not-a-date3 Nowhere           Nowhere             ZZ9 9ZZ   07700900003         bad@example.org                                   BADDATE

scenarios.why: CA-DOB is not a DATE: the INSERT fails (SQLCODE not 0), '90', the error message is written and the task returns
